hero.tagline: Computer science student with experience in software development. I like building things, figuring out how they work, and learning along the way.

about.label: About
about.heading: A bit about me.
about.p1: I'm Lukas, a computer science student based in Ulm. I completed my B.Sc. in Computer Science at HTWK Leipzig in 2026 as part of a dual-study programme, combining university coursework with practical software development at T-Systems International GmbH.
about.p2: During my time there, I worked on a large frontend project with Vue alongside a larger development team, as well as on a few smaller projects in different areas. Outside of university and work, I mostly build things because I find them interesting or want to understand how they work.
about.p3: These days, I mostly work with TypeScript, JavaScript and Python. I'm particularly interested in full-stack development, with a focus on the frontend, but I also enjoy working with Node.js, Express and databases.

experience.label: Experience
experience.heading: From theory to practice.
experience.desc: This timeline gives a quick overview of my academic background and the practical experience I've gained along the way. It starts with my current master's degree and goes back through my bachelor's degree and the practical work that was part of it.

entries.title: B.Sc. Computer Science
entries.desc: Completed a dual-study degree combining academic coursework with practical software development at T-Systems International GmbH. Worked primarily on a large Vue frontend project as part of a larger development team.

contact.label: Contact
contact.heading: Say hello.
contact.desc: I'm currently looking for a working student position where I can get more experience in software development and contribute to a real project. If you're looking for someone who enjoys learning, building things and getting into the details, feel free to get in touch.
